title: Structural scalar normalization from a given coherent realization
statement: Let f:X→S be quasi-compact and separated, E quasi-coherent [def-pc-scheme,def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. Suppose the higher image for the associated coherent unit coefficient has a module action and an isomorphism Φ to E_et [def-weil-pbc-coherent-higher-image-classes,def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison]. Assume this action on every canonical coherent cohomology class is induced by multiplication by the pulled-back base scalar, and Φ is linear for these actions. Then the higher image for actual additive structural functions admits an isomorphism to E_et with the prescribed scalar formula on canonical raw classes [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map,lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-class-compatibility]. No affine comparison family or existence of a coherent realization is asserted here.

proof.text: Map the inverse explicit unitStructureCoefficientIso through the fixed degree-one higher-image functor and compose with the supplied coherent realization Φ. This constructs Ψ with no choice of an arbitrary coefficient identification.

For z and zprime, unitCoherentRawClass_class identifies their transported higher-image classes with affineRealizationClass of their coherent raw evaluations. unitCoherentRawClass_scalar turns the assumed raw scalar relation into coherent multiplication on these evaluations. Substitute this equality, apply ha in reverse and then hl. The resulting section multiplication is definitionally unitRealizationSectionSmul.

theorem exists_unitRealizationScalar_of_coherentAction {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (action : ∀ V : S.Etale,
      Module (ULift.{u + 1} Γ(V.left, ⊤))
        ((affineRealizationHigherImage f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1).obj.obj
          (op V)))
    (Φ : affineRealizationHigherImage f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1 ≅
      liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf E)
    (ha : ∀ (V : S.Etale) (a : Γ(V.left, ⊤))
      (x : Sheaf.H (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf
        (affineRealizationCoefficient f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) V)) 1),
      affineRealizationSmul (action V) (ULift.up a)
        (affineRealizationClass f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1 V x) =
      affineRealizationClass f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1 V
        (Sheaf.H.map (coherentEtaleMap _ _
          ((affineRealizationCoefficient f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) V).smulHom
            ((pullback.fst V.hom f).appTop a))) 1 x))
    (hl : ∀ (V : S.Etale) (a : ULift.{u + 1} Γ(V.left, ⊤))
      (x : (affineRealizationHigherImage f
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1).obj.obj (op V)),
      Φ.hom.hom.app (op V) (affineRealizationSmul (action V) a x) =
        ULift.up (a.down • (@id Γ((tensorPullback V.hom).obj E, ⊤)
          (Φ.hom.hom.app (op V) x).down))) :
    ∃ Ψ : unitRealizationImage f ≅ liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf E,
      UnitRealizationScalar f E Ψ
